title: Hawk Over the Basin Fields
summary: Teaches the sickle as a hawk's talon, circling the field with qi, then plunging to hook and cut.

title: Dual-Track Canon of the Mirrored Sickles
summary: Trains a paired-sickle fighter to run two tracks of qi, one in each blade, mirroring and answering each other.

title: River-Crossing Hooks of the Azure Ford
summary: Applies the hook to fighting in fords, shallows and riverbanks, using the water's pull against opponents.

title: The Twin-Court Book of Hook and Counter-Hook
summary: Sets out a duel of hook against counter-hook as played in paired courts, each stroke answered by its twin.

title: Paired-Hand Sickle Studies of the Azure Basin
summary: Studies how each hand of a sickle fighter passes the cut to the other, in the rhythm of basin harvest.

title: River Floods and the Drawn Curve
summary: Shapes the sickle's draw after a rising river flood, gathering weight slowly and then breaking all at once.

title: Oath of the Plateau Sickle Bearer
summary: Binds the sickle bearer's cuts to a sworn bearing held against the plateau wind, however the fight turns.

title: Open-Sky Hooks for Those Who Keep No Walls
summary: Teaches fighters who keep no walls to hook and sweep in the open, using space itself as the guard.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Gusting Edge
summary: Turns the gusts into a second hand on the blade, driving cuts, hooks and spins with the wind.

title: Bearings Held on the High Plateau
summary: Trains the sickle fighter in the thin air of the high plateau to keep a bearing under any assault.

title: Sworn Hook of the Windward Edge
summary: Teaches the hook as an oath kept on the windward edge, pulling opponents toward the drop beside it.

title: Book of the Storm-Crossing Curve
summary: Carries the curve of the sickle through rain, thunder and lightning-lit dark, cutting where others lose their footing.
